messages:
elaine: Quick FYI — spotted a flaky example in error-reference: the 429 fallback sample assumes Retry-After header is present. In practice some infra responses embed retry_after in JSON body. Causing confusion for SDK users.

shreya: Can you paste the snippet and where it's failing?

elaine: ```python
# docs/error-ref/429_fallback.py (current)
resp = client.generate(prompt)
if resp.status == 429:
    wait = int(resp.headers.get('Retry-After'))
    time.sleep(wait)
    resp = client.generate(prompt)
```

elaine: The CI linter flagged a runtime test that uses body: {"retry_after": 3} and the example throws TypeError. Also the JS snippet lacks try/catch.

mike: I repro'd locally — runtime can return header OR body depending on proxy. Filed eng-runtime issue ENG-RUNTIME-1243. @eng-runtime could you confirm?

eng-runtime: Confirmed. Older proxies return JSON body key "retry_after" for 429; newer ones set Retry-After header. We'll add a compatibility field in the response metadata in next deploy, ETA Thu.

shreya: Plan: in docs PR we should update the example to check both header and body; add minimal JS+Py snippets, a tiny repro harness (scripts/429_repro) that can be run with docker-compose mock response, and add a short note in the migration guide. I'll own the PR.

anton: CI note — update the tests that assert sleep() was called: use a fake time patch instead of real sleep. I can add a small pytest fixture.

elaine: SGTM. Could we also add a short perf note about backoff/backpressure? People are copying this into prod.

shreya: Good call — add a 3-line section: exponential backoff with capped jitter and prefer client-side queueing over immediate retries.

mike: I'll add a test case for header vs body in the runtime issue to make sure the new compatibility field works.

shreya: Targeting branch docs/429-compat-snippets. Will open PR tonight. cc @anton for pytest fixes, @elaine for final content review.

docs-bot: Reminder: add 'docs' label and link to changelog entry. Use template 'docs-pr-template.md'.

elaine: Thanks — if PR's up I'll review tomorrow morning. :thumbsup:

shreya: Opening now — https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2894

anton: Quick heads-up — added fixture and updated test. Pushed to branch.

mike: Verified runtime test passing locally against mock. :white_check_mark:

shreya: Merged. Closing thread; will watch post-merge smoke tomorrow. :eyes:
